_about: Values of the game rules (battles, losses, time). The learning model is in learning.json.

grades._about: The grades that a player or a parent can choose. -1 is Pre-K, 0 is K. A grade with no "name" uses the text key grade.name with the number.

figures._about: The sizes of people. map and battle: the scale of an adult picture. child: the size of a child as a share of an adult (the hero and Gióng as a boy are children).

_maxProfilesAbout: The first version has one profile. The code and the saves support more.

loss._itemsAbout: Iron is not in this list, because the iron horse quest needs it.
